name: ax-e6b.2-apps-ax-generator
description: Acceptance contract for ax-e6b.2, minted BEFORE implementation (ADR-0008/0010). Proves the apps.ax generator: ONE App Definition (a typed `Listing` noun, the apis.directory dogfood) renders EVERY face from live state with zero per-face authoring (Projection Law, ADR-0006) — the faceted HTML directory (human register), the markdown-of-live-state twin (agent register, the net-new piece), the JSON API face, and CRUD create — with facets DERIVED from the Listing type's enum/relation fields (not hand-configured) and search. Screen law (ADR-0001) holds: same live state, two byte-consistent registers, one URL. Verified at the Worker HTTP seam against a local dev server; run: (start the apps.ax dev worker on 127.0.0.1:8790) then npx autonomous-qa verify http://127.0.0.1:8790 --spec docs/acceptance/ax-e6b.2.spec.json --expect-digest <pin>. Seed data (>=3 listings across >=2 categories) is loaded by the dev-server bootstrap so facets/search have something to bind. Rich UI polish + the full multi-tenant interpreter are out of scope (child issues).
